One hand belongs to one wrist; realistic thumb/finger arrangement and natural grasp. Skin natural medium Indian reddish-brown with dusty rose highlights rather than yellow; parent plain dusty-rose sleeve and child plain teal sleeve match reference. No people/faces/bodies, only partial forearms, hands and phone. No props. Render forearm ends softly fading to full alpha, no hard cutoff or edge contact.
